summary.text: Jeffrey Sean Adams, a Republican, represents House District 144 (Acton and Lebanon, York County) in the Maine House of Representatives, and lives in Lebanon. The House profile lists membership on the State and Local Government Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Maine House profile lists legislative service in the House during the 131st and 132nd Legislatures.
The profile gives business developer as the occupation and lists U.S. Air Force military service.
Listed affiliations are the American Legion, URC, Mason and IOOF.
